assets.concept: A few assignment stacks and one unfinished folder invite closer attention.
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Style reference: Image 1 is the portfolio's original Hi illustration. Match its friendly 2D cartoon language: bold dark charcoal/near-black clean outlines, warm flat color fills, confident simple silhouettes, expressive but restrained human gestures, and only a small amount of soft cel shading. Similar visual weight and finish to a custom Bitmoji-style editorial spot illustration. Use Image 1 for style ONLY: do not repeat its waving man, facial identity, Hi lettering, speech balloon, pose or crop.
Art direction: much simpler than a scene illustration. A compact group of a few large objects with generous clear space. Transparent background, no room, classroom, storefront facade, furniture-filled interior or scenic backdrop. A small desk or counter segment is permitted only when essential to the action. Black outlines with warm ivory, mustard yellow, muted sage, orange, peach and graphite fills, using each case's accent sparingly. No photorealism, elaborate textures, gradients, glossy 3D rendering, tiny decorative clutter, giant flat background panels or busy infographic arrows.
Text: no text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, headlines, readable interfaces, records, metrics or seals. Paper may contain a few simple nonverbal marks. No watermarks, image borders or rounded rectangular frames.
Human figures: simple anonymous fictional cartoon characters in the reference's friendly style, with plausible hands and facial structure; no photoreal faces. Every important hand and object is complete inside the frame. Illustration is conceptual, not evidence or a screenshot.
Asset type: simple editorial spot-illustration thumbnail. Horizontal 2:1 canvas, target 2048 x 1024 pixels. Transparent background. Keep the whole identifying subject inside the central 60 percent of width, surrounded by clear transparent breathing room, so a centered 120x80 or 88x64 crop still makes sense. Use thick readable outlines and a handful of large shapes.
Primary request: Two uneven stacks of ivory school worksheets on mustard and sage folders, with one open folder and a loose unfinished worksheet between them. A large pencil rests across the open folder. Use just these few large shapes, not hundreds of paper edges. The open unfinished work interrupts the otherwise orderly stacks. No teacher or classroom in the thumbnail.
